cutoverDecision.rationale: Rank03 and Rank02 are two independently selectable task representations under the same canonical number-line KP. Rank03 must therefore be projected as a sibling selector target, not as a duplicate KP row.
cutoverDecision.allSelectPolicy: Rank01 sibling, Rank02 canonical target, Rank03 sibling target and all other G3A-U01 canonical targets may be selected simultaneously in same-unit mixed mode.

routeAmbiguityPreflight.currentRank02Behavior: Rank02 single-KP public route currently accepts the canonical number-line KP even when selectedPatternGroupIds and patternSpecIds are empty.
routeAmbiguityPreflight.riskAfterRank03: Once Rank03 becomes a second public PatternGroup on the same canonical KP, KP identity alone is no longer sufficient to distinguish Rank02 read-value from Rank03 mark-value.
routeAmbiguityPreflight.requiredRepair: Rank02 canonical selector target must resolve explicitly to Rank02 PatternGroup/PatternSpec, and Rank03 sibling target must resolve explicitly to Rank03 PatternGroup/PatternSpec. No public leaf may dispatch by canonical KP identity alone after Rank03 cutover.

requiredChanges: project Rank03 PatternGroup as a same-level sibling selector target beside the Rank02 canonical number-line target
single-KP mode must allow choosing Rank03 sibling without minting a new KP
same-unit mixed mode must include both Rank02 canonical target and Rank03 sibling in all-select
sync selectedSelectorTargetIds to selectedKnowledgePointIds plus explicit selectedPatternGroupIds so two targets may share one KP

examUiPreflight.currentMechanism: selectorTargetsForSource and rankPatternIdsForTargetIds special-case Rank01 sibling only.
requiredChanges: add Rank03 sibling target to Exam selectorTargetsForSource
preserve both Rank02 canonical target and Rank03 sibling in same-unit mixed selection
preserve Rank03 explicit PatternGroup in cross-unit selectedPatternGroupIds
allow cross-unit plan to carry Rank03 selector target without collapsing it into Rank02 merely because both share one KP

sameUnit.currentMechanism: same-unit aggregator can already materialize multiple selector targets that share one KP through selectorTargetId plus forcedPatternGroupIds, but only Rank01 is wired.

crossUnit.requiredBehavior: cross-unit coordinator must preserve selector-target identity and forced PatternGroup semantics for both Rank02 canonical and Rank03 sibling leaves.

focusedContracts: selector projection exposes Rank03 exactly once as a sibling target
Rank02 canonical target remains visible exactly once
single-KP Rank03 generates marker-free questions and marked answers
same-unit all-select contains 11 targets and materializes both Rank02 and Rank03 leaves
cross-unit Exam materializes Rank03 beside another same-grade same-semester unit
deployedAcceptance: operator visual acceptance of marker-free question and marked answer layout

allowed: same-unit and cross-unit selector-target linkage design
forbidden: make Rank03 selector visible in this preflight milestone

nextStep: At the planning-to-implementation boundary, approve bounded Rank03 public selector cutover implementing the sibling selector target, explicit Rank02/Rank03 PatternGroup routing, same-unit/cross-unit linkage, and three-mode E2E.
